decision.summary: OPEN_POSITION: 77k DIP has become the cleanest May 22 daily thesis expression now that BTC is leaning bearish and the nearest downside strike is strongly repriced but still below the hard cap.
decision.rationale: Active strategy is beecthor. Reconciliation is clean, daily_success_cooldown is inactive, and there are no open BTC price-hit positions, so a fresh daily entry is allowed. The latest Beecthor thesis is still the 2026-05-20 bearish map, which is stale at D-2, but this cycle finally provides the exceptional confirmation required by the playbook: Binance short_term_bias has turned bearish_short_term, bearish-bias correction is no longer active, spot is around 77214, the UTC day is down about 0.52%, the 12h move is around -0.71%, and price is trading very close to the 77k line after failing to hold higher in the local range. On the May 22 board, 77k DIP Yes has repriced to about 0.785, which is a strong but still acceptable probability below the 0.90 cap, with roughly 10 hours left and only a small remaining move needed. That makes it the nearest conservative bearish strike with solid expiry validity. The REACH side was also evaluated, but 78k REACH Yes around 0.29 is now the wrong side of the live structure, while 76k DIP Yes around 0.14 is the next leg and no longer the closest-strike-first choice. This is the first cycle today where the stale bearish thesis is sufficiently confirmed to justify action.
